Hi Alice / Tom —

Great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement timeline: 

Call recap
- Parties: Acme Corp will be the data controller for customer data; Redwood will act as processor for hosted inference (hosted API) in our standard model. We noted potential private deployment options which could affect data residency controls.
- Compliance asks: you requested a DPA, confirmation of SCC approach for international transfers, SOC 2 report, and kickoff of our standard vendor security questionnaire.
- Data residency: preference for EU region (Frankfurt) — you said this is important for the initial rollout.

Attachments I added for your review: Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.pdf (draft DPA), SCC_Module_Mapping.xlsx (high-level mapping of SCC modules + options).

Proposed next steps
1) Please confirm controller/processor alignment (controller = Acme, processor = Redwood) — that will determine the SCC path.
2) If confirmed, legal can review the DPA draft and flag redlines (I cc'd Lukas from Legal).
3) We'll start the vendor security questionnaire once you confirm the main point of contact — Rishi (cc'd) will own that.
4) Please send any specific DPA requirements or clauses you must include (you mentioned data deletion windows and subprocessors).

Timeline suggestion: DPA redlines within 7 business days; questionnaire completed within 5 business days of kickoff. If this works, I can schedule a short follow-up to close the open items.

Thanks — and happy to hop on another call if useful.
